title: docs(spec): ActionSchema.params states the same-name param rule
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4vJbDdhEXMEdqXZQ6PPuGv)_

Fixes #28732

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`ActionSchema.params` 的描述多了一句同名参数规则：参数名（`name`，或字段型参数的 `field`）只能为同一个输入的按门控分身重复（`visible` / `requiresFeature` 不同）；只有每一处声明都必填时才算必填；值形状按第一处声明（`type`、`multiple`、`options`）。生成的参考文档随之更新。
- **为什么改**：#28707 让 `validateActionParams` 按这条规则合并同名声明，但规则只写在校验函数的注释里。写动作元数据的作者和 AI 读的是 schema 描述，看不到它。
- **风险与回滚**：极低。只改描述文字，没有新键、没有新门禁、没有改变任何接受或拒收的值。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`（`params` 的 `.describe()` 那一行）；`content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`（生成的参考表）。
- **两分钟验证**：`grep -n "may repeat only for per-gate variants" content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`，预期两行（`Action` 与 `InlineAction` 两张表的 `params` 行）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`**: the `params` member's `.describe()` keeps its first sentence and gains one more, stating the rule `validateActionParams` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts`) has applied since #28707: a param name (its `name`, or the `field` a field-backed param reads) may repeat only for per-gate variants of ONE input, declarations that differ in `visible` / `requiresFeature`; the params check treats the name as `required` only when EVERY declaration requires it, and judges the value by the FIRST declaration's shape (`type`, `multiple`, `options`), so that shape should stay identical across them.
- **Generated references**, regenerated by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:schema && gen:docs`, no hand edits: `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx` (two rows: `Action` and `InlineAction`), `ui/component.mdx`, `data/object.mdx`, `kernel/metadata-plugin.mdx`. The JSON Schema under `packages/spec/json-schema/` is build output, not tracked, and carries the same text after a build.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28732-action-params-same-name-rule.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `patch`. The description ships: it is in `dist` (the zod `.describe()`), in `json-schema/` and in `src/**/*.zod.ts`, all in spec's `files[]`.
- ⛔ No lint rule, gate or refusal, as the order ruled.

## Tests

No behaviour moved, so there is no new test and no ablation (os-dev: a description is not tested behaviour). The suites that read the schema stay green at head `157212e3`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: `Test Files 785 passed (785)`, `Tests 23206 passed | 1 todo (23207)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK` with the ledger held.
- `eslint packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts --no-inline-config`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Wording reach.** The order's sentence named `name`; the only repeated name in the tree, `sys_user.create_user`'s `email`, is declared through `field` (`{ field: 'email', … }` twice). The resolver keys by `name ?? field` (`ResolvedActionParam.name`: "inline `name`, or the resolved field name"), so the sentence names both spellings. Without it an author reading "a param `name` may repeat" could not tell a field-backed repeat falls under the same rule.
- **No case for a drift refusal.** The order asked for an open question only if a real case exists for refusing same-name declarations whose value shapes differ. #28707's census found no repeated name other than `create_user`'s `email`, and its two declarations read the same field, so their shape cannot differ. No producer writes a drifting pair, so no open question is raised (「新增门禁默认否」).
- **`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`**, measured: `check:authorable-surface` and `check:api-surface` are green with no regenerated artifact moving beyond the description text, and no accepted value changes.
